citation: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, Fatality Analysis Reporting System, 2019–2023 Final Files; U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2019–2023 5-year estimates, table B01003. Accessed September 29, 2026.
note: These are deaths in motor vehicle crashes in the county per 100,000 residents a year for 2019–2023. The value describes how dangerous the county's roads are for everyone, including people passing through. It is not the risk for one resident. Small counties with busy highways can have very high values.

datasets.title: Traffic deaths
datasets.method: FARS deaths in crashes located in the county, 2019–2023, divided by 5 times the ACS 2019–2023 population, times 100,000
datasets.note: Five-year average of deaths in crashes on the county's public roads per 100,000 residents. County details show the death count and the number of residents.
